home.heroTitle: Own a home in Japan, from Vietnam.
home.heroLead: Mainly older detached houses, plus condominiums, land and commercial space. Buy and manage property in Japan while you stay in Vietnam. A caretaker you can trust is in Japan on your behalf.
home.videoTitle: A Japanese husband and a Vietnamese wife. Together, we look after your home in Japan.
home.videoText: It is natural to feel uneasy about owning property in Japan. You may not know the language, the procedures, or whom to trust. The two of us will answer each of those concerns, one by one.
home.diagramLead: We stand between you in Vietnam and your house in Japan.

diagram.prosSub: Licensed real estate agent, judicial scrivener, tax accountant

points.title: In your own language
points.text: Huong, who is Vietnamese, handles interpreting, translation and explanations. You can check the contract in Vietnamese.

points.title: Caretakers you can see
points.text: Imura and Huong handle on-site inspections, tenant communication, building checks and property-tax procedures. You always know who is looking after your house.

points.title: From start to finish
points.text: We support you continuously, from finding a house to buying, managing and selling it. Sales and rental brokerage are handled by our licensed partner agent.

home.latestLead: Mainly older detached houses, plus condominiums, land, shops, warehouses and offices.
home.closingText: You do not need to have chosen a house yet. Ask us anything about property in Japan, in Vietnamese. Consultation is free.

flow.title: Process & costs
flow.lead: These are the steps for someone living in Vietnam to acquire a house in Japan. We show you all the documents and costs up front.

steps.title: Choose a property
steps.text: Browse properties on this site and consult us online.

steps.title: On-site inspection
steps.text: Imura and Huong visit the house and share its condition with photos and videos.

steps.title: Offer & price negotiation
steps.text: Our partner agent handles the purchase offer and negotiation. We attend and explain everything in Vietnamese.

steps.title: Prepare documents
steps.text: You prepare the documents listed below. We explain how, in Vietnamese.

steps.title: Sales contract
steps.text: The contract is signed in the presence of the licensed agent. Huong interprets.

steps.title: Payment
steps.text: We explain the payment procedure individually for each property.

steps.title: Ownership registration
steps.text: A judicial scrivener registers the house in your name.

steps.title: Handover & management
steps.text: You receive the keys and management begins. From here, we look after your house in Japan.

flow.docsLead: For Vietnamese nationals living in Vietnam.

docs.name: Proof of address
docs.text: A document showing where you live in Vietnam.

docs.name: Affidavit · Signature certificate
docs.text: Issued by the Embassy of Vietnam in Japan or a notary office in Vietnam. It replaces the Japanese seal certificate.

docs.name: Power of attorney
docs.text: Used when you cannot come to Japan, to entrust the procedures to someone else.

docs.name: Acquisition report
docs.text: When a person living abroad acquires property in Japan, a report to the government may be required.

flow.docsNote: The exact documents will be confirmed with our partner agent and judicial scrivener, and explained for each property.

costs.name: Property price
costs.text: The amount paid to the seller.

costs.name: Registration tax
costs.text: Tax on registering the change of ownership.

costs.name: Real estate acquisition tax
costs.text: A one-time tax on acquiring the house.

costs.name: Judicial scrivener fee
costs.text: The fee for the registration procedure.

costs.name: Translation · notarization
costs.text: Costs of translating and notarizing documents.

costs.name: Our support fee
costs.text: For inspection, interpreting and procedural support.

flow.costNote: Amounts vary by property. After consulting with you, we provide a quote for each property.

after.name: Fixed asset tax
after.text: Paid once a year. We handle the procedure on your behalf as your "tax agent".

after.name: Management fee
after.text: Our fee for building checks, tenant communication and similar work.

after.name: Repairs
after.text: As needed, depending on the building's condition.

flow.taxNote: Tax treatment depends on where you live and on the property. We confirm with a tax accountant and explain individually. Rules may change, so please check the latest information with the relevant authorities.

services.title: Services
services.lead: We support you continuously, from finding a house to selling it.

items.title: Property information
items.text: We introduce properties suited to investment: mainly older detached houses, plus condominiums, land, shops, warehouses and offices. We can also suggest properties suitable as housing for foreign workers.

items.title: On-site inspection
items.text: Imura and Huong visit the house and report its condition with photos and videos.

items.title: Purchase support
items.text: We attend the offer and negotiation, and explain the contract in Vietnamese.

items.title: Tax agent
items.text: On behalf of owners living abroad, we handle fixed asset tax procedures.

items.title: Rental management
items.text: We communicate with tenants and inspect the building. Tenant recruitment is done by our partner agent.

items.title: Sales support
items.text: When you want to sell, we support you until the sale is complete.

services.partnerText: Brokerage for property sales and rentals is carried out by our licensed partner real estate agent. We act as your point of contact and coordinate the procedures.

about.title: About us
about.lead: Caretakers you can see will look after your house in Japan.
about.whyTitle: In our own words: why you can trust us

people.name: Minoru Imura
people.text: Born in 1960 in Obu, Aichi. I still run a restaurant and a guesthouse. I started working with foreign talent in 2018, and Vietnam is the country I visit most often each year. I am here in Japan, and I will look after your house with my own eyes.

people.name: Huong
people.text: Born in Hanoi, Vietnam. Huong first came to Japan as a technical intern trainee and has also lived in Poland and the Czech Republic. With the motto “connecting Vietnam and Japan,” she gives attentive support from the first meeting right through to the day itself, so that everything moves forward without language worries. She now lives between Japan and Vietnam with her husband.
